description: What it does Verity Score is a Shopify-first AI-commerce audit platform. It checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI engines can read, verify and recommend a store's products. The audit reviews structured data, product information, claims and proof, then turns detected issues into prioritized, Shopify-specific actions.
